sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The "Kayaka Spoorthi Scheme" aims to provide financial assistance to women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) engaged in the leather industry. The goal is to promote self-sufficiency and economic independence by enabling these women to start or expand business activities related to leatherwork.
**Who is this for:** Self Help Groups (SHGS); Category: Women and Child; Sector: Financial Assistance

**Detailed Description:** The "Kayaka Spoorthi Scheme" aims to provide financial assistance to women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) engaged in the leather industry. The goal is to promote self-sufficiency and economic independence by enabling these women to start or expand business activities related to leatherwork. A group of 10 members receives financial support under this scheme.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - Financial Assistance of ₹2,50,000/- per SHG with 10 members.  **NOTE:** - Each member gets ₹15,000/- as a subsidy and ₹10,000/- as a loan from the corporation. - 33% representation for women artisans and 5% for physically challenged individuals.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process:** **Step-01:** Visit the official [Seva Sindhu Portal](https://sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in/Sevasindhu/English). **Step-02:** Choose "New Users Register Here" and fill in your Aadhaar Number and the Captcha code. **Step-03:** An OTP will be sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number. Enter the OTP to continue. **Step-04:** Once your DigiLocker account is created, click "Allow" to proceed. **Step-05:** Fill out your email ID, mobile number, create a password, and enter the captcha, then click "Submit". **Step-06:** You will receive OTPs on both your email and mobile number. Enter both OTPs and select "Validate". **Step-07:** Once validated, a confirmation message will indicate your registration is successful.  > **Applying for a Scheme::** **Step-01:** Go to [Seva Sindhu Portal](https://sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in/Sevasindhu/English) and select "Department & Services". **Step-02:** Select department "Social Welfare Department" and click on the scheme "Kayaka Spoorthi Scheme" **Step-03:** Click "Apply Online" and enter your registered email ID/mobile number and the OTP. **Step-04:** Select the scheme and provide your personal, address, and banking details as required. **Step-05:** Once submitted, you will receive an Application ID. You can use this ID to track your application status on the portal.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Social Welfare Department
**Tags:** Financial Assistance, SHG, Business Activities, Leather Industry
